title: unstructuredgrid to cellgrid
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkUnstructuredGridToCellGrid converting an Exodus unstructured grid to a cell grid, rendering with composite cell grid mapper and color series lookup table.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCellGridComputeSides](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridComputeSides.html) — cell grid compute sides.
- [vtkCellGridSidesQuery](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridSidesQuery.html) — cell grid sides query.
- [vtkColorSeries](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkColorSeries.html) — color series.
- [vtkCompositeCellGridMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCompositeCellGridMapper.html) — composite cell grid mapper.
- [vtkCompositeDataDisplayAttributes](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCompositeDataDisplayAttributes.html) — composite data display attributes.
- [vtkFiltersCellGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFiltersCellGrid.html) — filters cell grid.
- [vtkIOSSReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIOSSReader.html) — ioss reader.
- [vtkProperty](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkProperty.html) — property.
- [vtkRenderingCellGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderingCellGrid.html) — rendering cell grid.
- [vtkStreamingDemandDrivenPipeline](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStreamingDemandDrivenPipeline.html) — streaming demand driven pipeline.
- [vtkUnstructuredGridToCellGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnstructuredGridToCellGrid.html) — unstructured grid to cell grid.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
